subject: Next steps: on‑prem / air‑gapped deployment qualification for BioSynth
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Emily Carter <emily.carter@biosynthlabs.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-16T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps: on-prem / air-gapped deployment qualification for BioSynth

Hi Emily — great to meet you and the infra team on the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can qualify the Private (air‑gapped) deployment path vs Dedicated: 

Key items we covered
- Deployment mode preference: Private on‑prem, fully air‑gapped (no outbound allowed).
- Expected footprint: you mentioned ~8 GPUs to start (we'll confirm exact instance types).
- Operational constraints: strict change freeze windows (quarterly), local-only patching, no direct pull from public repos.
- Security controls: KMS/HSM integration required, audit logs retained for 3+ years.

What we need to confirm from your side
- Desired RTO/RPO for model-serving outages (e.g., minutes vs hours).
- Which exact hardware you plan to buy (GPU model + count) or whether you want Redwood to recommend validated configurations.
- Procurement contact / PO process (cc'd procurement if possible).
- Any approved on‑site windows for upgrades/firmware patches and blackout dates.

Deliverables from Redwood (attached)
- onprem-checklist.pdf — baseline operational checklist for air‑gapped installs.
- hw-capacity-table.csv — example capacity mapping (we can swap in your SKU list).
- redwood-private-deploy-sow-draft.docx — initial SOW template for Private deployments.

Proposed next steps
1) You confirm procurement contact and hardware SKU list by 2027-04-20.
2) Redwood provides an offline installer package and audit of compatibility (Aditya to lead).
3) Schedule a technical readiness call (30–45 min) next week to walk through the checklist — propose Tue 2027-04-20 10:00 PT or Wed 2027-04-21 14:00 PT.

If we can get the procurement contact, Monica will circulate a lightweight runbook template and we can start matching hardware to our validated matrix. Let me know which time works and if anything above needs correction.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

From: Dr. Emily Carter <emily.carter@biosynthlabs.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@biosynthlabs.com>
Date: 2027-04-16T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: on-prem / air-gapped deployment qualification for BioSynth

Hi Camila — thanks for the concise recap and the attachments. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Confirmed: this will be fully air‑gapped (no egress allowed except for approved maintenance via secured transfer).
- Hardware baseline: planning 8 x NVIDIA A100 80GB (we're finalizing the vendor quotes this week). We'll forward exact SKUs to procurement.
- Maintenance windows: we operate a quarterly change freeze; emergency patches are allowed but must be coordinated with our SOC and Ops teams.
- HSM: we will integrate an HSM (Thales) for secret management; need to confirm Redwood support for external KMS/HSM during install.
- Audit logs: 3 years retention is preferred; let us know if Redwood's audit export can be delivered offline.

Procurement <> Technical contacts
- Procurement: procurement@biosynthlabs.com (I've cc'd).
- Ops lead: Will Richards <will.richards@biosynthlabs.com> — I will intro him on the follow-up.

A short checklist would be very helpful — thanks for the attachments. Tue 2027-04-20 10:00 PT works for us for the technical readiness call. Please send a calendar invite and dial-in details.

Emily
Dr. Emily Carter
VP, Platform Engineering
BioSynth Labs
emily.carter@biosynthlabs.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-16T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Next steps: on-prem / air-gapped deployment qualification for BioSynth (needs SE + CS input)

Team — forwarding Emily's reply and the attachments. Quick asks before tomorrow's readiness call: 

Aditya (SE/infra)
- Can you confirm we have a validated offline installer flow and an approved method for HSM/KMS integration in air‑gapped environments?
- Any red flags for A100 80GB x8 (64 vram nodes) from a capacity / kernel compatibility standpoint?
- Estimate: how long for a full offline install smoke test (hours/days) if we supply an ISO and offline packages?

Monica (CS/ops)
- Can you draft a 1‑page runbook template (initial) showing on‑site patching steps, rollback, and contacts? We'll hand it to BioSynth ahead of the call.

Jordan (Sales lead)
- Pricing guidance: preliminary delta between Dedicated reserved capacity and Private (on‑prem) including an install fee + optional 12‑month on‑site support. We need a ballpark to set procurement expectations.

Attachments: onprem-checklist.pdf, hw-capacity-table.csv, redwood-private-deploy-sow-draft.docx.

I'll send the invite for Tue 2027-04-20 10:00 PT and include Will (Ops) once Emily confirms the intro.

Thanks — Camila

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Emily Carter <emily.carter@biosynthlabs.com>, Will Richards <will.richards@biosynthlabs.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@biosynthlabs.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: on-prem / air-gapped deployment qualification for BioSynth — checklist + meeting

Hi Emily / Will — thanks for confirming the time. Per request, attaching a pared‑down checklist for air‑gapped installs (attached: onprem-checklist.pdf) and a suggested SOW draft. Highlights for tomorrow's call: 

- Offline installer: Aditya will outline the offline package size and install flow (no internet required).
- HSM/KMS: we support Thales via PKCS#11; will validate with your HSM team during the call.
- Audit exports: Redwood can deliver encrypted audit bundles on a removable drive or via signed S3 transfer through an approved transfer node.
- Upgrade cadence: recommended quarterly maintenance with a documented rollback plan; emergency patching workflows exist but require SOC approval window.

Action items for BioSynth (pre-call)
- Share exact GPU SKUs and vendor names (procurement).
- Confirm a primary Ops contact for onsite coordination (Will, thanks for joining).
- Any blackout dates next 90 days for firmware or OS patches.

Proposed calibration items for procurement
- PO template (please send) so we can align SOW+payment terms.

Thanks again — calendar invite sent for Tue 2027-04-20 10:00 PT. Looking forward to walking through the checklist.

Best regards,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0147
